tutorial.text: Swipe across a fuse to snip it! You have a limited number of snips, so make each cut count.
Two fuses burn at the same time! Watch both — snip each before the fire reaches the bomb.
This fuse burns FAST! The spark races — cut the wick AHEAD of it before it reaches the end.
Sparks start one at a time — watch the delay, snip each fuse as it ignites. These wicks are STICKY: cutting near the match makes them snap back — let the spark reach the junction, then cut.
Every fuse passes through the same point. One well-placed cut snips them all!
See that fork in the wick? When the fire reaches it, a NEW wick lights from that point! The fork is sticky — cut the parent PAST the fork, then snip the new wick too.
Color-coded wires! Check the legend at the top of the screen: blue and purple are SAFE to cut. Red is a trap — cutting it gives one warning, then boom.
Some fuses run straight to the bomb — no crossroads to find. Track every wick, not just the crossings.
TWO wicks fork now. Both forks are sticky — cut each parent PAST its fork, then snip every new wick it lights.
Gold stars give BONUS snips! Cut close to a star to bank +1 — grab them to stretch your budget.
Water drops douse the fuse! A spark that reaches a drop snuffs itself — those wicks need NO cuts.
Water drops douse some wicks — but the color rule still applies! Read the legend before you cut: never touch the red wires, and let doused wicks burn themselves out.
TWO BOMBS! Sparks split between both targets — lose if fire reaches EITHER one. Watch both sides.
